title: CanonicalDSSOutputContract
description: Formal JSON Schema definition for Explainable Slow-Moving Product Risk DSS Payload

risk_level.description: Predicted slow-moving risk class from XGBoost classifier

predicted_risk_prob.description: Model predicted probability for slow-moving risk

demand_pattern.description: Intermittent demand classification pattern (e.g. Lumpy, Intermittent, Smooth, Erratic)

sales_velocity_90d.description: Observed 90-day sales velocity in units/day at t0

dsls_days.description: Days since last sale at t0

zero_rate_90d.description: Zero-sales day proportion in 90 days prior to t0

tsb_demand_prob.description: TSB intermittent demand probability parameter at t0

shap_top_evidence.description: Top contributing SHAP feature evidence list

business_cause_tags.description: Diagnostic cause tags assigned by Business Rule Engine

interpretations_vi.description: Vietnamese natural language interpretations for cause tags

recommended_actions_vi.description: Action recommendations mapped from cause tags and risk class
